# bioconductor-podcall

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **PoDCall** for: The package includes a shiny application which provides an interactive and user-friendly interface to the full functionality of PoDCall.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("PoDCall")
```

See files in `references/` for vignettes and tutorials.
